newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares dip on selective profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares dip on selective profit-taking.

text.p: 1720 GMT - Shares dipped on selective profit-taking, with non-residents selling Portugal Telecom and Cimpor. Banks helped lend a counter-weight with Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor hitting fresh highs.
*The mood on Thursday could depend on Portugal Telecom which should steady after losing just over one percent on Wednesday, traders said. It accounted for over 40 percent of turnover.
*The PSI20 .PSI20 index ended 0.25 percent down as overall bourse trade totalled 11.2 billion escudos.
*Telecel recovered from initial losses that followed the 1996 results, with profit up some 200 percent but slightly below the most optimistic forecasts.

*"I think that Telecom probably corrected enough this morning and could recover (on Thursday). The conditions are right and if Wall Street remains positive, that could give an additional lift," said one trader.
*The telecommunications company has lost some 3.7 percent in the past two sessions.
